# اُخْتُتِنَا (uḵtutinā) /ux.tu.ti.naː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِخْتَتَنَ (iḵtatana)
# اُخْتُتِنَّا (uḵtutinnā) /ux.tu.tin.naː/: first-person plural pas
